One enquiry

Bathroom supplies and tiles on one enquiry

Most bathrooms are bought from four or five different places. Here the tiles, the vanity, the bath, the toilet and the grate can go on one enquiry, so one team checks that the pieces work together.

What should you choose and measure for each bathroom item?

ItemWhat to chooseWhat to measure
VanityWall hung or freestanding, cabinet only or with a topThe wall width, the depth you can spare and where the waste pipe comes in
BasinAbove counter, inset, undermount or wall hungThe benchtop depth and the tap hole position
BathFreestanding, back to wall or cornerLength and width of the space, the doorway it has to pass through and the waste position
ToiletBack to wall, close coupled, wall faced or in-wallThe set-out from the wall to the centre of the waste, and whether it is an S trap or a P trap
Mirror or shaving cabinetLED, framed or plain, or a cabinet for storageThe vanity width and the wall height above the tap
Floor waste or grateSquare floor waste, linear grate or tile insertOutlet size, grate length and your tile thickness

A general checklist. Your plumber, tiler or builder confirms the measurements for your bathroom.

If you are buying bathroom renovation supplies in Sydney for the first time, start with the fixtures that set the plumbing: the toilet, the bath and the vanity. Then choose the tiles around them, and see bathroom tiles for floor and wall options that suit wet areas.

The range

Vanities, baths, toilets and mirrors

Vanities are the largest range, with 651 products in wall hung and freestanding designs. We supply bathroom vanities Sydney wide, with tops and tallboys to match. To go with them there are above counter and inset basins and LED mirrors, along with framed mirrors and shaving cabinets.

The bath range covers freestanding baths plus back to wall and corner baths. Toilets run from standard suites to in-wall cisterns and smart toilets. For the shower, there are frameless sliding shower screens and shower doors and floor wastes and grates, and for the finishing touches there are robe hooks and accessories.

Taps, mixers and showers have their own section: see our tapware range.

Pricing

How bathroomware is priced

31 bathroomware products show their price on this site, from $20 to $2,640. Where a product comes in several sizes or finishes, the card shows the starting price.

The rest of the range shows Enquire Now. Add those products to your enquiry and the team confirms the price for the size and finish you want before you commit to anything.

Availability

What is available and how to check

Bathroomware is bulky and comes in many sizes and finishes, so availability changes from one product to the next. Send an enquiry or call (02) 8786 0288 with the product names, and the team checks what can be supplied and how long it will take.

Check before your plumber is booked. A vanity or bath that arrives after the rough-in can hold up the whole job.

Planning

Planning a full bathroom with us

Bring a sketch of the room with the wall lengths, the door and window positions and where the existing waste pipes are. Photos on your phone help too.

Choose the fixtures first, because they fix the plumbing positions. Choose tiles next, then tapware and accessories in one finish. Put everything on one enquiry and we confirm prices and availability together.

Toilets, basins, baths and tapware have to be connected by a licensed plumber, so share your choices with your plumber before you order.

Warranty

Warranty on bathroomware

Each product carries its maker's own warranty, and the terms differ between a vanity cabinet, a ceramic pan, a toilet seat and an LED mirror. A warranty usually depends on the product being installed by a licensed trade and used as the maker describes.

Ask us for the warranty terms of the products on your enquiry, and keep your receipt and your plumber's details with them.

Delivery

Where we deliver in Sydney

We deliver across Sydney metro, and bathroomware can travel with your tile order. Bulky items travel on the same truck: we deliver toilet suites Sydney metro wide along with baths and vanities. Tell us the site address and whether there are stairs or a narrow side path, as large items need a clear way in.

The showroom is in Bonnyrigg in Sydney's south west. For bathroom supplies in Western Sydney it is a short drive from Fairfield, Cabramatta, Liverpool, Wetherill Park and Smithfield. Showroom: 43-45 Bonnrigg Avenue, Bonnyrigg NSW 2177. We are open Monday to Friday 7am to 5pm and Saturday 7am to 3pm.

Brands

Brands on the range

Most of the bathroomware comes from Poseidon and its KDK Home range: vanities, basins, baths, toilets, mirrors and shaving cabinets. Otti Australia adds 145 vanities, and Lauxes Grates supplies the linear and tile insert grates.

Each product page names its range, so you can match a vanity to the basin, mirror and tallboy made to go with it.

Sizes

Sizes to check before you buy

Three measurements cause most returns: the vanity width against the wall it sits on, the toilet set-out, and the bath length against the room and the doorway.

Vanities on the range run from 400 to 1800 mm wide, and baths from 1000 to 2000 mm long. Write your measurements down in millimetres and bring them with you, or add them to your enquiry.

Care

Looking after new bathroomware

Use a soft cloth and a mild, non-abrasive cleaner on ceramic, acrylic and vanity surfaces. Cream cleansers and scourers scratch acrylic baths and dull polyurethane cabinets.

Wipe water off vanity tops and cabinet edges, keep the room ventilated, and avoid bleach on coloured tapware and metal finishes. Follow the care sheet that comes with each product.

Bathroomware

Bathroomware questions

Can I buy a whole bathroom package from one place?

Yes. You can put tiles, a vanity, a basin, a bath, a toilet, a mirror, tapware and a shower grate on one enquiry at Bonnyrigg Tiles. The team checks prices and availability for the whole list together.

How much does bathroomware cost?

The 31 bathroomware products with a price on this site run from $20 to $2,640. The other products show Enquire Now, and our team confirms the price when you enquire.

How long does ordered-in bathroomware take?

It depends on the product, the size and the finish. Tell us what you need and when your plumber is booked, and the team will confirm the timing before you order.

Do you install bathroomware?

This site covers the supply of bathroomware. Toilets, basins, baths and tapware must be connected by a licensed plumber, so plan the installation with your plumber or builder before you order. Call (02) 8786 0288 if you have a question about a specific product.

Do bathroom products come with a warranty?

Yes. Each product carries its maker's warranty, and the terms differ by product. Ask us for the warranty terms of the products on your enquiry before you buy.

Do you deliver vanities and baths in Sydney?

Yes, we deliver across Sydney metro. Tell us the site address and the access when you enquire, and the team will confirm delivery for large items such as vanities and baths.

mainEntity.name: Can I buy a whole bathroom package from one place?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can put tiles, a vanity, a basin, a bath, a toilet, a mirror, tapware and a shower grate on one enquiry at Bonnyrigg Tiles. The team checks prices and availability for the whole list together.
The 31 bathroomware products with a price on this site run from $20 to $2,640. The other products show Enquire Now, and our team confirms the price when you enquire.

mainEntity.name: How long does ordered-in bathroomware take?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the product, the size and the finish. Tell us what you need and when your plumber is booked, and the team will confirm the timing before you order.

This site covers the supply of bathroomware. Toilets, basins, baths and tapware must be connected by a licensed plumber, so plan the installation with your plumber or builder before you order. Call (02) 8786 0288 if you have a question about a specific product.

mainEntity.name: Do bathroom products come with a warranty?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Each product carries its maker's warranty, and the terms differ by product. Ask us for the warranty terms of the products on your enquiry before you buy.

mainEntity.name: Do you deliver vanities and baths in Sydney?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we deliver across Sydney metro. Tell us the site address and the access when you enquire, and the team will confirm delivery for large items such as vanities and baths.
